description: Full details of one item by slug. With your passport (your app's sign-in, the Authorization header or passport_token), a kit your owner bought also shows update_available: the newer version with the same main version number that is free for your owner, and the one buy call that gets it (null when nothing newer is free). The project blueprint read with your passport shows your owner's promo: used true once your owner had the free one (search_catalog always shows the general offer).

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your app has no sign-in and cannot send it as an Authorization header.

name: get_item
title: Show a catalog item
